no_adcom_quote.quote: Your application for Erleada (apalutamide) was not referred to an FDA advisory committee because outside expertise was not necessary; there were no controversial issues that would benefit from advisory committee discussion.

summary: No FDA advisory committee was convened for NDA 210951 (Erleada/apalutamide) for non-metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer. The February 14, 2018 approval letter states the application was not referred to an advisory committee because outside expertise was not necessary and there were no controversial issues warranting committee discussion. Accordingly, there are no AdComm-driven linkages to the approval.
